description: The PRODUCTION-side companion to ai-tell-corpus.json. ai-tell-corpus catches tells (what to avoid). This file is positive guidance plus the freshest 2026 blacklist that detection should also catch. It feeds `node bin/ai.cjs voice` (prompt builder) and is referenced by FORGE-DOCTRINE.md. Where ai-tell-corpus is regex-for-blocking, this is human-readable doctrine-for-generating.
source: Synthesized from 2026 editorial research (Olivia Cal AI-tells blacklist May 2026, image-physics guides, TTS prosody work) + our own finding that tell-clean copy can still read AI.

blacklist_2026._note: Newest tells, beyond the original corpus. Add the regex versions to ai-tell-corpus.json AIT-EN-FILLER/EXALTATION as they prove out. Pairs term -> what a person says.

hook_transitions.here's the kicker: (link the ideas, don't announce the turn)

hedges.in conclusion: (end on a thought or an ask)

positive_targets._note: What `voice` injects as REQUIREMENTS, not bans. These push toward a voice instead of away from a tell.
positive_targets.burstiness: Mix sentence lengths on purpose. After a long winding sentence, drop a short one. The reader feels rhythm before they can name it.
positive_targets.specificity_with_grit: At least one concrete detail only an insider would know. Not 'a busy night' — 'the POS dies Friday 7pm, two cooks short'. In-world: real numbers, real item names, the unglamorous true detail.
positive_targets.stance: Pick a side. State Y directly; cut the 'not X, it's Y' setup. A real opinion that risks alienating some readers is the signature of a person.
positive_targets.first_10_percent_cut: The real sentence is usually the second one. Open in the conflict, not in the throat-clearing.
positive_targets.pub_test: Read it aloud. If you wouldn't say it to a friend over a beer, rewrite it until you would.
positive_targets.human_ending: End on a final thought or a call to act. Never summarize what you just said.

the_three_questions: Specific? — a gritty insider detail, or the statistical average of the internet?
Uneven? — does the rhythm vary, or is it a smooth rectangle of 15-20 word sentences?
Imperfect? — a stance / a flaw / a breath, or sanded to a beige sheen?
